notes.title: Update 4
notes.content: In the new update, we added an avatar in the center of the screen that shows who the next move is. In the game settings you can change the size or exclude it.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
The new version of the game has added support for custom avatars.
In the directory of the game on the way Monopolist Technological Revolution_Data\StreamingAssets\ are 5 standard avatars. To replace one of them, just copy your image with a file replacement. For this, the names must match.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
In this update, we added the following features:
• Press the F key to turn on the follow car mode
• Press the C key tol turn on the free camera mode
• Now the text of the player's name will be highlighted when it moves

notes.title: Update
notes.content: In the new versions, we added the ability to select the avatar for the players, changed the camera control on WASD, unlocked the "Content" button. Try it out.
